body.x: THINKWARE(www.thinkware.com), a provider of location-based services and smart car devices, introduced "THINKWARE Dash Cam" at CES Unveiled, a pre-show of CES 2015 which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.THINKWARE Dash Cam is a DVR surveillance device with an automatic start-stop loop recording. Also, it supports incident recording, manual recording and motion detection recording.Its Safety Camera Alert features realtime traffic enforcement camera alert for speed camera and red light camera locations. And the Road Safety Warning System provides warning for Advanced Driver Assistance System(ADAS), including Lane Departure(LDWS) and Forward Collision(FCWS) warning systems.THINKWARE specializes in manufacturing high quality digital dashboard cameras tailored for motorists. THINKWARE Dash Cam F750 was named 2015 CES Innovation Awards Honoree for outstanding design and cutting edge engineering.
